name: Bitwarden
description: Your Bitwarden vault in Dock2: search it, copy from it. Copies are concealed and cleared after 30 seconds.
author: Dock2

network.reason: Signs in to your Bitwarden server and syncs your vault from it.

query.reason: Finds the items in your vault as you type, once you switch its results on.

clipboard.write.reason: Copies passwords, usernames and codes, concealed, and clears them after 30 seconds.

secrets.reason: Keeps your session in the Keychain, so the vault opens without your master password until it locks.
